Topic/sub-topic structure and competencies extracted with AI assistance (Gemini) directly from this module's own stated content — never invented; the extraction was instructed to use only what the module itself says, and to flag anything unclear rather than guess. Covers only the term this specific module addresses (Term 2) — other terms are not included since no source document for them was available at extraction time. AI-flagged completeness notes from extraction: Heading styles vary significantly across the module text: some sections use 'TOPIC:' and 'SUB-TOPIC:' explicit prefixes, while materials like 'PLASTICS' and 'OTHER MATERIALS' appear without the explicit 'TOPIC:' prefix, though they share equal structural weighting and competency declarations. In GRAPHICS, the topic overview explicitly mentions four sub-topics (Drafting Aids, Plane Geometry, Symbols, and CAD), but only 'PLANE GEOMETRY' contains detailed text content in this document fragment. AI-flagged completeness notes from extraction: The module text displays several structural irregularities, inconsistent numbering, and missing components: 1) Under TOPIC: GRAPHICS, the overview states the topic covers four subtopics ('i) Drafting Aids, ii) Plane Geometry, iii) Symbols, and iv) Introduction to Computer Aided Designs (CAD)'), but the module text completely omits 'Drafting Aids' and 'Plane Geometry', providing content only for 'SYMBOLS' and 'INTRODUCTION TO COMPUTER AIDED DESIGN (CAD)'. 2) Under TOPIC: MECHANISMS > SUB TOPIC: LEVERS, the competence is explicitly labeled as 'Specific Competence 2', but there is no 'Specific Competence 1' present. 3) Under TOPIC: DESIGNING > SUB-TOPIC: DESIGN PROCESS, there is duplicated learning activity numbering: two consecutive entries are labeled 'LEARNING ACTIVITY 3' (Describing the situation and Deriving a design Brief) and two are labeled 'LEARNING ACTIVITY 4' (Carryout research and Formulating Design Specification). 4) Under TOPIC: ENTREPRENURSHIP > SUB-TOPIC: BUSINESS PLAN, learning activity numbering jumps abruptly from an unnumbered first activity to 'LEARNING ACTIVITY 11' and 'Learning activity 12'. 5) In Entrepreneurship, Learning Activity 11 is titled 'Marketing plan (Financial Plan)', erroneously mislabeling the Financial Plan section under the Marketing Plan heading. 6) No week numbers are assigned or mentioned anywhere throughout the module text.

subject.name: Design and Technology
subject.description: Design and Technology syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: MATERIALS
topics.description: Covers the fundamental materials used in Design and Technology, including their properties, production, practical applications, environmental impacts, and safe usage in manufacturing products.

sub_topics.name: MATERIALS-MANUFACTURED BOARDS
sub_topics.description: Focuses on utilizing manufactured boards in product making using tools for measuring, marking, cutting, testing, finishing, and applying edge treatments.

competencies.description: Utilise manufactured boards in different situations

sub_topics.name: MATERIALS – METAL
sub_topics.description: Covers properties and classification of metals, iron and steel production, non-ferrous extraction, practical fabrication, environmental impacts, recycling, and workshop safety.

competencies.description: Use metals in different situations

sub_topics.name: PLASTICS
sub_topics.description: Explores plastic identification, physical and mechanical properties, chemical structure, forming processes, tool manipulation, environmental impacts, practical applications, safety protocols, and conservation strategies.

competencies.description: Use plastics in different situations
Utilise plastics in different situations

sub_topics.name: OTHER MATERIALS
sub_topics.description: Examines non-traditional materials such as reed, grass, leather, glass, ceramics, canvas, rubber, and fiberglass, focusing on their properties, environmental effects, tool manipulation, safety, and sustainable reuse.

competencies.description: Utilise other materials in different situations

topics.name: GRAPHICS
topics.description: Covers basic knowledge, skills, values, and attitudes on graphical communication to effectively convey ideas and concepts using internationally recognized symbols and drawings.

sub_topics.name: PLANE GEOMETRY
sub_topics.description: Focuses on the study of shapes, sizes, and positions of objects on a flat surface, including constructing, inscribing, and circumscribing triangles and quadrilaterals for product designs.

competencies.description: Construct triangles from given data
Construct quadrilaterals from given data

topics.name: ENERGY
topics.description: Focuses on energy sources used to power daily life in homes, workplaces, and industries, categorizing them into renewable and non-renewable energy sources.

sub_topics.name: SOURCES OF ENERGY
sub_topics.description: Covers identifying, classifying, analyzing advantages and disadvantages, and designing systems to harness various renewable and non-renewable energy sources.

competencies.description: Utilise sources of energy

topics.name: STRUCTURES
topics.description: Examines different types of structures that provide support, stability, and functionality to products, buildings, and engineering systems.

sub_topics.name: STRUCTURES
sub_topics.description: Focuses on identifying and classifying natural, artificial, frame, shell, and mass structures, researching their properties, analyzing causes of structural failure, and applying structural design principles.

competencies.description: Apply knowledge on structures in different situations

topics.name: MECHANISMS
topics.description: Focuses on mechanical systems and motion analysis, allowing product designers to predict mechanism performance, speed, acceleration, and efficiency.

sub_topics.name: MOTIONS
sub_topics.description: Covers identifying, analyzing, sketching, and applying four primary types of motion—linear, rotary, reciprocating, and oscillating—in product design and mechanical development.

competencies.description: Apply motions in various situations

topics.name: ENTREPRENEURSHIP
topics.description: Provides guidance on organizing business information to evaluate commercial viability and develop a comprehensive business plan for managing successful ventures.

sub_topics.name: BUSINESS PLAN
sub_topics.description: Focuses on understanding and formulating the key components of a business plan, including executive summary, business description, and marketing plan elements like product description, pricing, target selection, sales strategies, and advertising.

competencies.description: Develop a Business plan

topics.name: MATERIALS
topics.description: Covers the journey of materials from raw form to finished products through manufacturing processes, focusing on joining methods and holding tools.

sub_topics.name: MANUFACTURING PROCESSES
sub_topics.description: Explores temporary and permanent joining methods for metals, wood, and plastics, as well as the identification, safe usage, care, and maintenance of various holding tools.

competencies.description: Join materials using different methods
Use holding tools in product making

topics.name: GRAPHICS
topics.description: Covers visual communication concepts, symbols across technical disciplines, and two-dimensional Computer Aided Design (CAD).

competencies.description: Share ideas, thoughts, information and messages through graphics language.
Coming up with ideas of graphics and products that would solve a real-life problem.

Understand the critical process needed when constructing lines, angles, triangles, quadrilaterals, and symbols. Such processes will help learners to understand how each plane figure is interconnected to the other.
Adopting the best graphical solution to a real-life challenge.
Gaining a skill of how to manipulate software tools when designing various artefacts or objects
Acquire a step by step skill on how to identify, analyse, and find graphical solutions to challenging situations.

sub_topics.name: SYMBOLS
sub_topics.description: Covers identification, design, and application of standard graphical symbols used in building construction, welding, electrical, mechanical, pneumatics, and hydraulics.

competencies.description: Design symbols

sub_topics.name: INTRODUCTION TO COMPUTER AIDED DESIGN (CAD)
sub_topics.description: Covers CAD software interfaces, command tools, basic 2D drawing (lines, circles, arcs, shapes), and auxiliary editing/dimensioning tasks.

competencies.description: Produce Computer Aided Drawings in 2-Dimesion

topics.name: MECHANISMS
topics.description: Covers mechanical systems designed to transfer or transform motion and force, with a focus on levers and linkages.

competencies.description: Express themselves using different media and symbols as they make a presentation on mechanisms, i.e., motions, levers, and linkages
Participate fully in the group towards accomplishing given tasks and projects through mechanisms.
Break down complex information on mechanisms into components that would be easy to understand and help in creating interconnected mechanical systems.
Generate new ideas and products by applying new processes and introducing new techniques that can add value to the way mechanical systems are used in comparison to the existing ideas.
Conceptualising, applying, analysing, synthesising, and evaluating information to form a judgement or guide a belief or action of the environmentally friendly designs of structures.
Identify, analyse, and find solutions to mechanical system failures, and devise new, stronger systems.

sub_topics.name: LEVERS
sub_topics.description: Covers the three classes of levers, principles of moments, force calculations, and real-world applications of lever systems.

competencies.description: Apply levers in different situations

sub_topics.name: LINKAGES
sub_topics.description: Covers types, operations, design principles, and applications of connected lever mechanisms such as reverse motion, parallel motion, push-pull, bell crank, pantograph, and crank mechanisms.

competencies.description: Apply linkages in different situations

topics.name: ELECTRONICS
topics.description: Covers electronic components, conventional circuit symbols, and the construction/testing of basic electronic circuits.

competencies.description: Breaking down complex information on electronic components so that it would be ease to understood and help in creating interconnected electronic systems.
Express themselves using different media and symbols as they make presentations on different electronic components and how they can be utilised in electronic circuits
Participate fully in the group towards accomplishing given tasks and projects on designing electronic circuits.
Generating new ideas and products by applying new techniques that can add value to the way electronic systems are used in comparison to the existing ones.
Conceptualising, applying, analysing, synthesising and evaluating information to form judgement or guide a belief or action of the environmentally friendly electronic designs.
Identifying, analysing and finding solutions to electronic systems challenges and inventing new systems.

sub_topics.name: ELECTRONIC COMPONENTS
sub_topics.description: Covers identifying components, interpreting and drawing conventional circuit symbols, and utilizing components (diodes, resistors, transistors, capacitors, LEDs, switches) in simple circuits.

competencies.description: Utilise electronic components

topics.name: DESIGNING
topics.description: Covers practical problem-solving using the systematic design process.

competencies.description: Identify a problem from a given situation.
Work with others to complete tasks
Relay information using drawings.
Design products innovatively.
Analyse a given theme.
Identify problems in a given situation.

sub_topics.name: DESIGN PROCESS
sub_topics.description: Covers the initial stages of the design process: theme identification, theme analysis, situation description, problem identification, design brief derivation, research, and design specifications.

competencies.description: Apply Design Process stages in problem-solving.

topics.name: ENTREPRENURSHIP
topics.description: Covers business planning tools and entrepreneurial knowledge to evaluate and manage business ventures in Design and Technology.

sub_topics.name: BUSINESS PLAN
sub_topics.description: Covers formulating key parts of a business plan, including organizational structure, financial planning, and compiling a complete business plan.

competencies.description: Develop a Business plan.
Generate a Business Idea
